crossRefs.note: Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.
Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!
In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul…
For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those…
Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
“Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…
Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will…
After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the…
He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.
He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.
He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch.”
Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

translations.web: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.
translations.bsb: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
translations.kjv: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
translations.asv: For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto Sheol.
